title: More Information
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM

The formula class that supports critical peak prices CL_ISU FASTEDM FORMULA CPP contains an algorithm that calculates the
actual consumption for a time-of-use exception period including past periods. These quantities are available from the results
parameters of formula execution in the billing process as operand values and can be used in rate calculations. The algorithm in this

formula represents a typical CPP rate. You can use this TOU formula as a basis for additional project-specific formula
implementations.

More Information

For more information, see the documentation for the formula class CL_ISU FASTEDM FORMULA CPP in the system.

Setting Up Conditional Billing

You must perform the following activities to set up conditional billing:

1. Define time-of-use exception programs.

You use TOU exception programs for example to represent demand response programs in the SAP IS-U system. TOU
exception programs bundle TOU exceptions and create the connection between the conditional billing program and the
TOU exception.

For more information, see

Defining Time-of-Use Exception Programs

2. Design rate constructs for conditional billing.

a. Define the rates that you want to use as basic rates and those that you want to use as conditional rates. Use the
rates in a corresponding schema and in rate determination. Select the Execute Conditional Billing Program
indicator in the schema and the rate category.

1 Note

You can usé a billing schema for which this indicator is selected, in a rate category for which this indicator is not

selected. If you do so however, the system ignores all conditional rates for the billing schema extension during
billing.

b. Select the Assignment to a Conditional Rate Allowed indicator in the time-of-use interface. This enables the time-
of-use interface to be assigned to a rate that is to be used as a conditional rate in a billing schema extension.
3. Create billing schema extensions for the schemas.
For more information, see
Create Billing Schema Extension
4. Define conditional billing programs in the billing schema extension and assign them to TOU exception programs.

Assigning conditional billing programs to TOU exception programs executes the corresponding rates in the billing schema
extension for an active TOU exception.

5. Define rate relationships between basic rates and conditional rates in the billing schema extension.
